messages.subject: INLA + Compositional data
parts:
Dear all,
I am new to INLA, and I was wondering if the INLA approach can be used with to formalize Bayesian Hierarchiacal Models with compositional datasets, i.e. when data provide portions of a total. Compositional data are multivariate: the value of a variable is meaningful in relation to the amounts of the other variables. 
Any of you have esperience on that kind of datasets?

Fabio
